summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.35/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.35 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 22, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 34¢ higher than a week ago, 48¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.52 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($4.20) and the highest in Merrill ($4.51).
